findings.summary: The tests copy the real repo .gitignore into a scratch repo, so they fail if the ignore rule is removed. That is a good regression binding. The scratch repo has no commits, so the tests depend on syncParentUntrackedFiles behaving correctly with an unborn HEAD. I did not run them, so CI is the check. AC4 (the PR body states whether Step 0.5 ignores .claude/ by design) cannot be checked from the diff.
